text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 약점: 총자산이익률(ROA) 5.3%.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Weakness: Return on assets 5.3%.

text.en: Very strong within its sector. Strength: 3-yr revenue growth (annual) 14.5%.

text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 강점: 설비 노후도(감가상각누계액 비율) 14.6%. 약점: 차입금의존도 48.1%.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Asset age (accumulated depreciation share) 14.6%. Weakness: Borrowings to assets 48.1%.
About average for its sector. Strength: Price to earnings 15.03x.

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경의 영향은 중립적이에요. 주요 요인: 물가 상승 압력 국면 (유리). 부채가 많은 편이라 금리 영향이 더 커요.
text.en: The current economy is roughly neutral for this sector. Main factor: rising inflation (helps). Higher debt makes it more rate-sensitive.
